4mannick: Otto Mannick arrived with the Day 15 draft, carrying his mother's thimble and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Otto Mannick lost a boot in the trench. Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
A grenade burst short of the parapet at M-F11. Otto Mannick took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood.
axel_chasserant: The draft reached R-S5 on Day 8. Viktor "Button" Chasserant was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Viktor "Button" Chasserant offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Viktor "Button" Chasserant fought Dietrich Dependentkin in a trench no wider than a door. Viktor "Button" Chasserant came home with Dietrich Dependentkin's cap badge. (@dependentkink_____) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Viktor "Button" Chasserant hit Felix Zulfi with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@rayan.zulfi) The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Viktor "Button" Chasserant read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The men argued about whether fish sleep. Viktor "Button" Chasserant said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor "Button" Chasserant is number 508. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Button" Chasserant stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Viktor "Button" Chasserant measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
Viktor "Button" Chasserant mended the hole in Oskar Reynolds's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Oskar says the patch is stronger than the trousers.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Viktor "Button" Chasserant was hit through the stomach at R-S5. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Viktor "Button" Chasserant has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. The bleeding has stopped. Viktor "Button" Chasserant asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.

A medic brought Viktor "Button" Chasserant half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor "Button" Chasserant. Viktor "Button" Chasserant read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Viktor "Button" Chasserant survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-S5, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. Viktor "Button" Chasserant reported for duty as a machine gunner. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
A clear shot from R-S5. Viktor "Button" Chasserant grazed Severin Honeybadger and slid back down below the parapet.
bakerthebakerthebaker: Nobody asked Dorian "Brick" Bakerthebake why he came. Nobody in W-F7 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
cain_597: Walter Cain arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a tin whistle and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
comrade_pawington: The new rifleman is Konrad "Mud" Pawington, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Konrad "Mud" Pawington said he would find out.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Walter "Saint" Williemcminn, grazed. Konrad "Mud" Pawington cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Konrad "Mud" Pawington felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F10. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Konrad Manthatsment of the Concord (@manthatsmental1). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Konrad "Mud" Pawington shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Three days with a bandage, and Konrad "Mud" Pawington is back at Q-F10. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Konrad "Mud" Pawington helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Konrad "Mud" Pawington's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A second spoon disappeared. Konrad "Mud" Pawington searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.

Konrad "Mud" Pawington fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Emil Sup was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. A bullet hit Konrad "Mud" Pawington in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Jonas Justafungi of the Concord (@justafungi77).
Someone moved Konrad "Mud" Pawington's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
The medics called Konrad "Mud" Pawington 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Konrad "Mud" Pawington is back on the line.
The colonel asked who held the line at Hill 304 last night. Every finger pointed at Konrad "Mud" Pawington. Lance Corporal.
ditrih_88: The new rifleman gave his name as Marek Ditrih. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Marek Ditrih signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Marek Ditrih looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell landed close to R-F12. When the dust settled Marek Ditrih was still there, holding a bullet that missed him, laughing without sound.
Marek Ditrih cut Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

Dawn watch. Marek Ditrih put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, grazed. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Marek Ditrih folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Marek Ditrih fired at a movement across the wire at R-F12. The man went down: Dietrich Jackson, grazed.
A clear shot from R-F12. Marek Ditrih grazed Karel Pavla and slid back down below the parapet.
Asked what he will do after the war, Marek Ditrih said: 'Be a postman in Old Harrow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Marek Ditrih saved the last of the sugar for Dorian Austintress's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Dorian's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Marek Ditrih walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Marek Ditrih was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Marek Ditrih wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Marek Ditrih on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
A crow sat on the parapet above Marek Ditrih all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Marek Ditrih rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Tobias Hill was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.

The sergeant at R-F12 called out a range and a spot. Marek Ditrih was the only one who hit it. Dorian Shpkunky was gravely wounded. Marek Ditrih borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe was badly wounded.
Marek Ditrih won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in R-F12. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Marek Ditrih raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F12. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Valentin "Button" Boi of the Concord (@gremlin_boi32).
dj_triplejjj1120: "You're late," said the corporal when Teodor Triplejjj arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Isidor Serrano's name scratched on it. Teodor Triplejjj kicked it back. It did not come again.

Teodor Triplejjj accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Teodor Triplejjj wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Teodor Triplejjj raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F20. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).
A bullet found Teodor Triplejjj at S-F20, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bastian "Crow" Jwger of the Hegemony (@jwger87).
The medics would not give up on Teodor Triplejjj. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F20 today.
Teodor Triplejjj pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Calvary Farm and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Teodor Triplejjj looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The tapping under Calvary Farm is closer. Teodor Triplejjj and two others work in silence, in socks, by the light of one candle. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Teodor Triplejjj answered to number 310. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Teodor Triplejjj wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Teodor Triplejjj and Severin Guy divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Teodor Triplejjj washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
Teodor Triplejjj broke through into the enemy gallery at dawn. It was empty. A lamp was still warm. He blew it out and placed the charge.
Teodor Triplejjj wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Teodor Triplejjj was on watch at S-F20 when the night raid hit. The men found Teodor Triplejjj at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Bastian Bloom of the Hegemony (@carson._.bloom).
The House of Triplejjj sent another. Quentin "Hollow" Triplejjj, older brother of Teodor Triplejjj, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
A bullet hit Quentin "Hollow" Triplejjj's belt buckle at S-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Nils Weyer of the Hegemony (@wout.vd.weyer).
guerric.dbrt: Dietrich Dbrt found a place in U-F17 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Dietrich Dbrt during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet hit Dietrich Dbrt's belt buckle at U-F17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Gustav Here of the Concord (@champ_is_here_6981).

Dietrich Dbrt returned to U-F17 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Dbrt. Dietrich Dbrt read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Dietrich Dbrt became a sapper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
Dietrich Dbrt crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at U-F17 holds again.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Chalk Pits every night, fed by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg on one side and Dietrich Dbrt on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.

Dietrich Dbrt was on watch at U-F17 when the night raid hit. The men found Dietrich Dbrt at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Isidor "Button" Etpepsic of the Concord (@d1etpepsic0la11).
Konrad "Smokes" Dbrt asked about Dietrich Dbrt on arriving at U-F17. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of U-F17. When Konrad "Smokes" Dbrt challenged it, there was nobody there. A letter came for Konrad "Smokes" Dbrt with a ribbon tied around it. Konrad "Smokes" Dbrt kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
j14ar08g06: The quartermaster asked Valentin Jarg to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Valentin Jarg and Arno Isaacburston argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Valentin Jarg wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Valentin Jarg checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Valentin Jarg took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

A bullet struck Valentin Jarg below the ribs at R-F1. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Gustav "Brick" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring). A single shot at R-F1. Valentin Jarg sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Gustav "Brick" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring).
Pavel "Bones" Jarg had heard about Valentin Jarg's courage. At R-F1, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Lightning lit Blackwater Canal and Pavel "Bones" Jarg saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.

Pavel "Bones" Jarg was on the dawn watch at R-F1 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Pavel "Bones" Jarg was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Pavel "Bones" Jarg watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Three days with a bandage, and Pavel "Bones" Jarg is back at R-F1. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel "Bones" Jarg is number 345 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F1, Pavel "Bones" Jarg listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Pavel "Bones" Jarg woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
Pavel "Bones" Jarg tried to describe the smell of Northwick and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
Pavel "Bones" Jarg found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel "Bones" Jarg worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Pavel "Bones" Jarg added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Pavel "Bones" Jarg. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
jimjamjom_: Florian Jimjamjom arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Orders came through: Florian Jimjamjom is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a letter he never sent.

Florian Jimjamjom fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Edmund Thswastim, now gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Florian Jimjamjom before dusk. Florian Jimjamjom read it twice and slept a little easier. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Florian Jimjamjom wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A shell hit the latrine at Q-F10. Nobody was hurt. Florian Jimjamjom says it was the best day of the war. A letter from home reached Florian Jimjamjom before dusk. Florian Jimjamjom read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Jimjamjom and Konrad "Mud" Pawington sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Florian Jimjamjom shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Benedikt "Owl" Dutch, was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Florian Jimjamjom before dusk. Florian Jimjamjom read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Jimjamjom spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Florian Jimjamjom before dusk. Florian Jimjamjom read it twice and slept a little easier.

Florian Jimjamjom went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Konrad Lfie was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@4lf__ie) Florian Jimjamjom went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A thin letter reached Florian Jimjamjom. Only five lines long, and Florian Jimjamjom knew every one of them by heart before supper.
Florian Jimjamjom fired at a movement across the wire at Q-F10. The man went down: Jonas Justafungi, grazed.
jiri.satalik: Bram Satalik took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bram Satalik was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Bram Satalik put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Bram Satalik during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet clipped Bram Satalik's helmet at R-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bram Ahmadhcj of the Hegemony (@ahmadhcj07).
Bram Satalik's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Bram Satalik watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Bram Satalik wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Bram Satalik left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.

A bullet went through Bram Satalik's sleeve at R-F11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Xiii of the Hegemony (@masis_xiii). Bram Satalik fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Bram Satalik is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Bram Satalik raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_).

Bram Satalik's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F11 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Satalik helped stack spare sandbags at R-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The recruit sat beside Bram Satalik at supper but left before the talk began. Bram Satalik passed the bread without trying to start a conversation. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-F11 with the rations. Bram Satalik ate while listening to the revised orders.
Asked what he will do after the war, Bram Satalik said: 'Be a brewer in Wyvern Cross. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
The recruit corrected Bram Satalik's account of a football match. It was the longest sentence anyone had heard from that end of the bench.
At supper, the recruit was arguing about football before Bram Satalik arrived. He had to ask for room on the bench.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F11 through the wire. Bram Satalik gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.

Bram Satalik was on the dawn watch at R-F11 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Bram Satalik was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Konrad Summer of the Hegemony (@summer.l_21).
A medic brought Bram Satalik half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
just.nic.thats.it: Walter Thats arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F17 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Walter Thats spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. A letter from home reached Walter Thats before dusk. Walter Thats read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Walter Thats kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
New laces made Walter Thats's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.
Walter Thats tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Walter Thats put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Walter Thats approved the method.
Walter Thats delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.
Walter Thats took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure.
kyrenhaong12: The sergeant gave Florian Kyrenhaong a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Florian Kyrenhaong got a letter from Elias. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Florian Kyrenhaong did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The shelling stopped while Florian Kyrenhaong was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
A bullet hit Florian Kyrenhaong's belt buckle at T-F21 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Roland Samot of the Concord (@samot0423).
The wound on Florian Kyrenhaong's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Florian Kyrenhaong wrote back to Elias and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F21 and grazed Florian Kyrenhaong's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Wendel "Bones" Dyl of the Concord (@__dyl_g).
Florian Kyrenhaong wore a fresh bandage at T-F21 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour.
luismarone: Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone arrived with the Day 14 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A parcel came for Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping. Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone became a sniper today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone free. A letter for Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone said the whole street was asking about the front. Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone did not know where to begin the answer.

Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at V-F19. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Felix "Parson" Theman of the Concord (@willdan_theman). Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone stood up to fix a loose sandbag at V-F19. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Felix "Parson" Theman of the Concord (@willdan_theman).
Isidor "Saint" Luismarone had heard about Ulrich "Bones" Luismarone's courage. At V-F19, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
missyandlogan: On Day 11 Bastian Missyandloga took a post at U-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He counts everything: steps, shells, stars, and the men liked him for it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bastian Missyandloga did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Rumour reached U-F4 that the war would be over by spring. Bastian Missyandloga has heard it before. So has everyone.
Bastian Missyandloga of the Hegemony and Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Bastian Missyandloga tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Bastian Missyandloga spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.

The Concord raiders came over at U-F4 in the middle of the night. Bastian Missyandloga met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Pavel Hite of the Concord (@kigh_as_a_hite).
Henrik "Smokes" Missyandloga took the same post at U-F4 where Bastian Missyandloga stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Henrik "Smokes" Missyandloga rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
nathanielenzo_073: Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz unpacked a photograph gone soft at the edges at R-C7. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz is number 656. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz and Hugo Ozsezgin carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.
Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang was grazed.
Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz watched a crack in an old stone wall through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves.

A single shot from across the wire hit Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz in the thigh at R-C7. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni of the Hegemony (@zaboravljeninemanjic).
Clement "Brick" Nathanielenz spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
pansinik.37: Cyril "Mud" Pansinik introduced himself as a glassblower from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril "Mud" Pansinik let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Cyril "Mud" Pansinik checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Cyril "Mud" Pansinik answered to number 850. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-C1 changed before the cheering ended. Cyril "Mud" Pansinik shouldered another load.
Cyril "Mud" Pansinik had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Cyril "Mud" Pansinik received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Cyril "Mud" Pansinik caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-C1 and grazed Cyril "Mud" Pansinik's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Nils "Ghost" Moregano of the Concord (@moregano_1).
The medic cut the last bandage off Cyril "Mud" Pansinik's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C1 the same hour.

Cyril "Mud" Pansinik (Hegemony) and Lucien "Hollow" Moonroleen (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at the Hanging Bridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
sc_maloy: Day 10: Ulrich Maloy reached P-F2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Ulrich Maloy borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Maloy. Ulrich Maloy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F2. Ulrich Maloy has learned to walk bent double.
Ulrich Maloy had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dietrich Hofmann crossed it, Ulrich Maloy fired. Dietrich Hofmann was grazed.
Ulrich Maloy has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Ulrich Maloy fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Roland Gdot, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Ulrich Maloy of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads. Yann Zannwaffen of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Ulrich Maloy saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at P-F2 and fired once. Edmund "Ghost" Sealy was badly wounded.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Ulrich Maloy's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
stanleyl_itfc: The quartermaster asked Wendel "Spark" Itfc to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached N-F17 with the rations. Wendel "Spark" Itfc ate while listening to the revised orders.
Wendel "Spark" Itfc and Konrad Tripletonyt made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Wendel "Spark" Itfc borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Wind kept turning the pages of Wendel "Spark" Itfc's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.
Wendel "Spark" Itfc fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Henrik Shokun, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Wendel "Spark" Itfc was hit hard in the fight at N-F17 before anyone could fire. The raider was Hugo Rambo of the Hegemony. Raider: Hugo Rambo of the Hegemony (@burger_rambo).
The wound on Wendel "Spark" Itfc's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
stickus_b: Roland Stickus introduced himself as a clockmaker from Oakmere. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-S10 with the rations. Roland Stickus ate while listening to the revised orders.

Roland Stickus is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland Stickus stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Roland Stickus wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Roland Stickus buried two men at the edge of the Drowned Farm and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time.
Roland Dr and Roland Stickus carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.

Roland Stickus was hit in the forearm at T-S10. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Konrad Site of the Hegemony (@conors_site).
The medic cut the last bandage off Roland Stickus's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to T-S10 the same hour.
Bram "Parson" Dumbasian wrote a letter for Roland Stickus's mother, because Roland could not find the words. Roland signed it.
stinchgaming25: Isidor Stinchgaming told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

The flare went up just as Isidor Stinchgaming reached the Concord parapet. Isidor Stinchgaming jumped down first. Wendel "Whistle" Luxos was the man waiting there, and Wendel "Whistle" Luxos fell. (@luxos8000) The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Isidor Stinchgaming did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A new trench junction cost Isidor Stinchgaming ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon. Isidor Stinchgaming got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 631. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-S17 changed before the cheering ended. Isidor Stinchgaming shouldered another load.
Isidor Stinchgaming repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at S-S17 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Isidor Stinchgaming. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.
Old Tom the crow follows Isidor Stinchgaming along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Isidor Stinchgaming ran six messages in one night. The last one was a request for more runners.
Somebody in S-S17 wanted to shoot Old Tom for the pot. Isidor Stinchgaming stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Isidor Stinchgaming read a theatre review while peeling supper.
ta7mira2: Jonas Mira came up on Day 9 carrying news from Dunmarrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Jonas Mira looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Jonas Mira read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. The clerk counted the names twice. Jonas Mira is number 685 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Mira watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Shell splinters caught Jonas Mira in the chest and belly at R-C14. The medic worked with both hands and shouted for a bed. A shell burst in the trench at R-C14. The men around Jonas Mira were thrown aside and lived. Jonas Mira took the worst of it and was killed at once.
The papers say Nils Mira. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Jonas Mira's eyes. Nobody in R-C14 argues.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Nils Mira. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Nils Mira. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

During a lull at the Bone Quarry, Nils Mira called across from the Concord line. Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Nils Mira shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Nils Mira never sits with his back to the parapet. Today, under fire at the Sunken Road, that habit was the only steady thing in R-C14.
tawt_us: Viktor "Owl" Tawt arrived at Q-F4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Viktor "Owl" Tawt wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Viktor "Owl" Tawt fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Cyril "Button" Collinhaney was gravely wounded. After the loss of Grey Mill, Viktor "Owl" Tawt helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet hit Viktor "Owl" Tawt in the neck at Q-F4. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta). Viktor "Owl" Tawt stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F4. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Felix Volta of the Hegemony (@esteban.volta).
Pavel "Lucky" Tawt came to the front because his uncle Viktor "Owl" Tawt never came home. He carries a key to a house that is no longer there.

A round went through Pavel "Lucky" Tawt's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Viktor Kizr of the Hegemony (@ki11z3r6.0). The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Pavel "Lucky" Tawt fired, and Severin Montblackz was grazed.
The wound on Pavel "Lucky" Tawt's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Pavel "Lucky" Tawt counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.

Pavel "Lucky" Tawt was on watch at Q-F4 when the night raid hit. The men found Pavel "Lucky" Tawt at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
Dietrich Tawt asked about Pavel "Lucky" Tawt on arriving at Q-F4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Dietrich Tawt aimed just below it. Quentin "Lucky" Stnmz was badly wounded.
wihanholtzhauzen: "You're late," said the corporal when Leopold Wihanholtzha arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Felix Crobus lent Leopold Wihanholtzha a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S1, Leopold Wihanholtzha listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A supply man offered Leopold Wihanholtzha a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Leopold Wihanholtzha answered to number 598. After the loss of Grey Mill, Leopold Wihanholtzha helped stack spare sandbags at R-S1. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Leopold Wihanholtzha was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Viktor Ghost of the Hegemony (@gaunt_ghost_611).
Leopold Wihanholtzha no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Leopold Wihanholtzha coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Leopold Wihanholtzha has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Nils "Mud" Tacomeister, badly wounded.
The sergeant at R-S1 called out a range and a spot. Leopold Wihanholtzha was the only one who hit it. Viktor Ssprinklez was grazed.
Leopold Wihanholtzha fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Silas Paulus was badly wounded.
yurboixav: Wendel Yurboixav took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Wendel Yurboixav was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Wendel Yurboixav did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F11. Wendel Yurboixav took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy).
An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Wendel Yurboixav was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Wendel Yurboixav did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Wendel Yurboixav watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The field hospital let Wendel Yurboixav go. He came back up the line on foot because the truck would not wait.
Wendel Yurboixav was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Wendel Yurboixav heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.
A round went through the rim of Wendel Yurboixav's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Edmund Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak).

Wendel Yurboixav rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F11 with the rations. Wendel Yurboixav ate while listening to the revised orders.

The extra voice came back during Wendel Yurboixav's test. It was talking about potatoes, which made enemy spies an unlikely explanation. Grey Mill is lost. Wendel Yurboixav heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Wendel Yurboixav shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Wendel Yurboixav approved the method.
Wendel Yurboixav traced the fault to two badly insulated wires touching near a junction. One of them belonged to the supply office.

Wendel Yurboixav was carrying water up to S-F11 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Wendel Yurboixav did not. Shot by Edmund Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Wendel Yurboixav fell at S-F11 and never moved again. Shot by Edmund Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy).
The House of Yurboixav sent Oskar Yurboixav after Wendel Yurboixav. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Viktor "Bones" Jcortes of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near Hill 304. Oskar Yurboixav of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
The party came back from the Chalk Pits by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Oskar Yurboixav.
